name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-02-19, at wavelengths from 1.46 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
